chartGroups.name: Lines heard, a run is out

classes.end: Between passes: a run is out, a start stamp under a minute old; a run's lines are lost
classes.rule: Every run's lines are judged once: a run that wrote its record has its lines sent, or the record is still on disk for the next pass, or the pass holds it on its way to `_judged`.
classes.cause: the pass marked a record read and died before it sent its lines, so what jmerge said of those pull requests never reaches anyone
